changelog.notes: Legacy trial exported from ClimMob v2 records into release schema v2.0.

study.title: Common bean tricot trial 2019_kedidagamela_haricotbean, Kedida Gamela, Southern Nations, Nationalities, and Peoples, 2018
study.description: On-farm tricot evaluation of common bean varieties by smallholder farmers in Kedida Gamela, Southern Nations, Nationalities, and Peoples, Ethiopia, under the Integrated Seed Sector Development (ISSD) Ethiopia programme. Part of the dataset 'Citizen science in Ethiopia contests prevailing assumptions in formal seed systems concerning men and women smallholders preferences for crop varieties and traits revealing their latent demand for diversity' (v1.0, 2025-06-03).

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites without coordinates take the mean of other sites in the same adm3 before rounding.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept, with spacing and capitalisation standardised
